contradicting_evidence: A directional downside case remains material: broad losses, weak ETH/BTC, contracting stablecoin supply and BTC ETF outflows are mutually consistent headwinds.
Negative funding, position reduction and extreme fear permit a meaningful countertrend rebound, so near-term weakness need not determine the weekly endpoint.
The settled ETH ETF session was modestly positive, contradicting an interpretation of uniformly negative institutional flows.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A volatile week containing rebound attempts and renewed weakness is plausible, but neither a lower nor higher endpoint is sufficiently established. NO_EDGE is uncertainty about net direction, not a forecast of a narrow sideways range. The structural recovery scenario supplies no verified turning day.
falsification_conditions: Persistent multi-session price losses, weak participation and continued ETH/BTC deterioration, reinforced by further liquidity or settled-flow weakness, would establish a clearer DOWN edge.
Durable price recovery with executed spot demand, strengthening ETH/BTC and broader participation would establish a clearer UP edge; improving settled flows would strengthen that conclusion.
missing_evidence: Several sessions of price structure and participation showing whether the current selloff persists or repairs.
Repeated settled ETF flows, updated liquidity observations and a BTC-dominance sequence.
Independent evidence that recovery extends beyond BTC and the observed Top-100 proxies.
supporting_evidence: The observations establish current stress, but not whether deleveraging is near completion or will continue throughout the week.
Liquidity contraction and poor participation weigh against recovery, while negative funding and position reduction leave substantial rebound uncertainty.
Longer-window altseason measures show weak relative participation, but do not resolve the next seven days' absolute market direction.
